# Historical EWS Part2 changes dispatch while the message callback retains exposure and status gaps

Part 2 replaces legacy OnError/error enums with optional fallible-listener dispatch and moves success callbacks outside inner unit Results, ignoring their returned status. The historical message callback inherits the new interface, but its supports table lists only IEwsMessageCallbacks; Rust QIs the fallible listener and handle_error only logs when absent. Its NotifyListener also shadows the supplied status with FolderUri result before forwarding. Thus this source does not prove end-to-end failure notification. Later current handler exposes both interfaces and forwards status through mOnStop after DB updates; Part 3 Boolean behavior and every DB-failure path remain separate. No callback, sync or compile test ran.

Scope: EWS Part2 cross-language sync completion.
